description: Source discovery queue for international case imports. Listing a collection does not authorise copying, publishing or mapping individual incidents.

sources.name: GEP UFO/UAP case data 1972–September 2026
sources.note: On 2026-11-01 GEP e.V. explicitly declined permission to make its UFO/UAP case dataset available for commercial purposes. Do not import, mirror, extract records from, or use this dataset to populate Disclosure Desk, including through a public copy, absent new express permission or legal review. Link to GEP publicly as an external research source only. No GEP dataset records imported.

sources.name: CNES GEIPAN case search
sources.note: Preserve A/B/C/D classification and changes; individual source and approximate town location required.

sources.name: Arquivo Nacional OVNI collection
sources.note: Brazil's National Archives documented 743 mixed archival records in 2018 (1952–2016), not 743 unique sightings. Official SIAN requires access and may have newer records; obtain stable individual ARX catalogue identifiers and verify re-use rights before importing. No coordinates or witness narratives.

sources.name: USSR Setka (1978–1991) and Russian archives
sources.note: Published account by Setka coordinators discusses roughly 3,000 reports, but the official underlying records are not verified as a downloadable public catalogue. AFU describes about 1,200 private Russian report files from 1993, not official government records. Do not import private datasets or assume count/rights. Seek primary archival identifiers and permitted access.

sources.name: Parliament Digital Library government UFO/UAP records
sources.note: Official Lok Sabha archive has 2004 question 133 (UFO sighting in Himachal Pradesh) and 2012 question 562 (Indo-China border); preserve parliamentary answer and question dates separately from incident dates. 1965 parliamentary debate includes official possible weather-balloon explanation. Search earliest through latest years; do not assume these are distinct unresolved incidents.

sources.name: South African historical UAP case-source discovery
sources.note: Do not copy third-party sighting databases without permission; review original reports and city-level locations.

sources.name: Additional African country archives
sources.note: Country-by-country source review; distinguish reports from independently investigated incidents.

sources.name: DGAC SEFAA official resolved cases by year
sources.note: Official SEFAA publishes resolved-case year links (2018–2026). Identify stable individual case identifiers, distinguish resolved explanations from unidentified reports, check reuse conditions; do not import case texts or precise locations without review.

sources.name: Chinese UAP historical and official-source discovery
sources.note: Canadian government Sky Canada report describes Chinese UFO research history and reports on PLA tracking, but no independently verified accessible government case-level catalogue yet. Seek direct PRC government links; distinguish journalism and private society records from government case files. Translate carefully and verify commercial reuse.
